text:
morgan: Following the postmortem, we identified a pattern of KV eviction spikes on primetime. Need concrete runbook + playbook edits, owners, and a pager flow. Who can take which pieces?
incident-bot: Postmortem report: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-eviction-patterns 4d6 Raw logs and traces attached.
priya: I'll own the playbook edits (escalation matrix + paging steps). @ash can you draft the quick triage commands we want ops to run first?
ash: Happy to. Draft below, keep it minimal so SRE on-call can act quickly. Comments welcome.
ash: ```
# KV eviction quick triage (for on-call)
1) Check pods: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
2) Tail runtime logs: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 150 | egrep -i "evict|kv_cache|oom"
3) Metrics snapshot: curl -sS http://monitoring.internal/api/metrics?service=runtime | jq '.kv_cache, .mem_usage, .gpu_util'
4) If kv_cache.evictions > 100/min: reduce batch config and restart gateway:
   kubectl patch configmap rt-config -n inference --patch '{"data":{"batch_size":"2"}}'
   kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
5) Post-restart: confirm warmup and sample inference: curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz && echo 'prompt' | http --body POST http://rt-gateway.internal/v1/generate
6) If problem persists > 15m: page @oncall and create INC ticket. If customer on Dedicated plan, page @dedicated-esc and cc customer-support.
```
claire: I'll add a short test script that runs the sample inference after step 5 so we can automate smoke checks in the runbook.
dan: I'll be runbook owner and will push doc updates to docs/runbooks/kv-evictions.md. Target PR by 2026-04-02.
priya: For the paging rules: page @oncall for >15m, page @runtime-leads if remediation not applied in 30m, page @eng-sre for repeated evictions (3+ in 24h). Include escalation table in playbook.
morgan: Can we make action items with due dates? I'll track in postmortem follow-ups.
priya: Proposed action items: 1) Runbook update (dan) - INC-7901 - due 2026-04-02; 2) Triage command snippets + test script (ash + claire) - INC-7902 - due 2026-03-30; 3) Escalation matrix in playbook (priya) - INC-7903 - due 2026-03-29.
nash: ACK. I'll throw the commands and a small bash smoke test into a gist and link in the PR. Also adding a note about auth required for rt-admin endpoints.
dan: Opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1950 4e6 tagging @priya @ash for reviews. ETA merge 2026-04-02 EOD.
priya: Once PR merges, I'll update the internal pager policy and notify support rotation.
morgan: Sweet. Also let's add a recurring short eval to detect regression pattern: weekly job that checks eviction rate and emails runtime-leads if above threshold. Add as follow-up in INC-7901.
claire: I'll prototype the weekly check and post results to #eng-alerts in staging first.
morgan: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop when all INCs are resolved. :thumbsup:
